instruction: Add a function `chunked(iterable, size)` to iterutils.py. It returns a list of lists, each containing up to `size` consecutive items from `iterable` in order; the final chunk may be shorter; an empty iterable returns []. It must accept any iterable (including generators and strings, where each chunk is a list of characters). `size` less than 1 must raise ValueError. Do not change `flatten()`. All tests in tests/test_iterutils.py must pass.
